en: A sepia-toned postcard showing the front façade of a long brick building complex on a quiet street. The left section resembles residential or institutional housing with multiple windows and dormers under a tiled roof, while the right section has a taller gabled hall with large vertical windows and decorative brickwork. A simple sidewalk, lamppost, and low brick-and-metal fence run along the street. The caption at the bottom reads "Voorgevel, Vermeerstraat."
